findings.how:
Done:
- Offers expire 25 s after they reach the screen, counted as a Not now. The time scales with More time.
- A press on an offer: or conn: button within 500 ms is ignored, and the arm time is kept while only the words change.
- Unsolicited offers (ssh seen, WSL) claim 'reply', so they wait behind an answer being read.
Lead's call, round 2: I took the bounded park. overlay.ts parks Ember beside any bubble with buttons so they don't run away from a pointer heading to them. Not parking would make Bring Ember unclickable, because the follower moves the bubble with the pointer. Parking only when the pointer heads towards the bubble would be a follower change in the overlay package. The expiry now bounds the park, as an answer's reading time does. docs/COMMANDS-WSL-SSH.md §4.1, where the offer is described (§2.7 is 'What Copilot gets back'), now says Ember holds still while an offer is up, for 25 s or ten times that with More time (e7edefd).
Not done (optional): when an offer_connect offer expires, the conversation's answer that waited behind it ('I've shown a Connect button…') still shows. Dropping it would discard the model's other words, which the Conversation section keeps anyway.
findings.test: targets-runtime 'offers in the bubble (review #14)': three tests (expiry, press too soon, waits behind an answer) failed before and pass now. Also presenter 'keeps its buttons' time on screen while only its words change'. The bounded park is a docs change with no test.

findings.how: Runtime bubbles use six looks: notice (no chip, neutral face), good (no chip, happy), working (Working, focused, no thinking glow), decide (Needs you, curious), trouble (Problem, worried) and failed (Problem, sad). Presenter.notice takes a mood, and the signed-out notice is 'attention', as the greeting is. Round 2 regression fixed (405c550): AgentHost withdrew its not-ready notice by raw text and only in mood error. notice() shows forBubble(text), and the signed-out notice is 'attention', so a notice that no longer held stayed up 12 s (36 s with More time). withdraw() now matches b.thought === forBubble(text) in mood error or attention, while nothing is busy.
findings.test: host.test 'Needs you' pins (failed before, pass now). Round 2: host.test 'a notice saying why Ember couldn't answer goes once that no longer holds'. 'offline…': ask while unreachable, the network comes back (networkChanged), status ready, bubble hidden at once. 'signed out…': ask signed out, sign in, bubble hidden at once. Both failed on the round-1 branch ('expected true to be false') and pass now.

AgentHost still withdraws the notice by its raw text (host.ts:1379 `this.unreachable = why`; host.ts:705 `presenter.withdraw(this.unreachable)`). withdraw() (presenter.ts:732) needs `b.mood === "error" && b.thought === text`. Scenario: the network is down and the user asks. The bubble shows "I can't reach Copilot / I can't reach GitHub right now. I'll try again when the network is back." The network comes back and the status turns ready. withdraw("Ember can't reach GitHub right now. It will try again…") matches nothing, so the stale notice stays up to 12 s, or 36 s with More time. The same happens to the signed-out "I need Copilot first" after the user signs in. Evidence: scratch tests built on the fix branch's Presenter (notice, then withdraw with the same raw text) fail in both cases. The same tests on 1b39bb3's Presenter pass. No host.test covers it, and the full suite is green.
verifierProblems.fix: Make withdraw match what notice() put on screen. Either compare `b.thought === forBubble(text)` and accept mood "attention" as well as "error", or have notice() record that a notice is up (a flag or its shown text) and have withdraw() hide on that. Add a host.test: ask while offline (and while signed out), bring the status to ready, and expect the bubble hidden at once.

verifierProblems.what: Presenter.fail() titles the bubble with `problemTitle(said)` and never passes `this.provider` (the session.error path does pass it). On an install that uses the organisation's model service, conductor.ts:543 fails with friendlyError(..., {provider:true}). The bubble then reads title "I can't reach Copilot" over the text "I can't reach your organisation's model service right now…". Any other failure there falls back to "Copilot had a problem". A scratch test confirmed the wrong title. This also breaks #228's "one name" rule.
verifierProblems.fix: Call `problemTitle(said, this.provider)` in fail(), and add a presenter test with provider=true.

verifierProblems.what: The keyboard route under error-mood bubbles is for the eye only. These are "Lost build-01" [Reconnect][Stop trying], "Can't reconnect", the sign-in-again bubble's siblings, and "Can't connect" [Try again][Close]. announcement() appends the step row only in attention mood. The rendered live region for an error bubble with step "Or press Ctrl+Alt+E and go to Computers." reads "Ember has a problem: Can't connect to build-01. …" with no route, so a screen-reader user is still never told how to reach Reconnect. Separately, "Read all" and "Read the last answer", which the finding lists, still have no keyboard route (no global shortcut, nothing says where).
verifierProblems.fix: In packages/bubble announcement(), add the step after the text for mood "error" when one is present. Extend the bubble.test for #52 to cover it. Give "Read the last answer" a global shortcut, or name the Conversation section in settings under a cut-short answer.

verifierProblems.what: "More time to read and answer" makes bubbles last three times as long and questions wait 6 minutes. The settings.ts comment cites WCAG 2.2.1, which asks for the limit to be turned off, adjusted to at least 10 times, or extended. Three times meets none of these. The reviewer's other half, a global shortcut for "Read the last answer", is not done.
verifierProblems.fix: Offer "Keep messages until I close them" (no auto-hide, questions wait 20 minutes or more), or scale by 10 (the presenter already clamps at 10). Otherwise drop the WCAG claim from the comment. Add the shortcut, or track it as a known limitation.

verifierProblems.what: This one is partial, and the fix agent says so. Expiry (25 s, as Not now), the 500 ms arm and waiting behind an answer all work: they fail on the base and pass now. But overlay.ts still parks the follower for any offer with buttons, so an unsolicited "You're connected to build-01" still freezes Ember. It now lasts up to 25 s, or 75 s with More time. A related leftover: when an offer_connect offer expires, the conversation's answer that waited behind it ("I've shown a Connect button…") then shows with no button.
verifierProblems.fix: The lead decides. Either don't park for offers posted with claim "reply" (or park only once the pointer heads towards the bubble), or accept the bounded park and record it in docs §2.7. Optionally drop or shorten a conversation answer that waited behind an offer that expired.
